messages.content: 請給我羅浮宮博物館的「Wonder of Nature」展覽和大英博物館的「Age of Reptiles」展覽的詳細資訊，包括兒童和成人的參觀費用。

function.name: museum_exhibition_detail
function.description: Provides details of a particular exhibition in a museum, including the cost per visit for different age groups. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

visitor_type.description: Age group of the visitor. Default is: ['adult']

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function twice: one for Louvre Museum (羅浮宮博物館) exhibition "Wonder of Nature", and one for British Museum (大英博物館) exhibition "Age of Reptiles". Provide details including child and adult fees.

We need to use the function with parameters: exhibition_name, museum_name, visitor_type optional. We can call with visitor_type ["child","adult"] or separate calls? The function returns details of a particular exhibition, including cost per visit for different age groups. So we can call once per exhibition with visitor_type default adult? But we need both child and adult. We could call twice per exhibition: one with visitor_type "child" and one with "adult". Or we can call with visitor_type ["child","adult"] if allowed. The function signature says visitor_type?: "child" | "adult"[], so it can accept array. So we can pass ["child","adult"]. That will return details including cost per visit for different age groups. So we can call once per exhibition with visitor_type ["child","adult"].

Thus two calls:

1. museum_exhibition_detail({"exhibition_name":"Wonder of Nature","museum_name":"Louvre Museum","visitor_type":["child","adult"]})

2. museum_exhibition_detail({"exhibition_name":"Age of Reptiles","museum_name":"British Museum","visitor_type":["child","adult"]})

We need to output the results. We'll call the function.
